description: This file implements MKLDNN (oneDNN) pooling operations for PyTorch, including max pooling, average pooling, and adaptive average pooling, with support for both enabled and disabled MKLDNN compilation.

methods.name: mkldnn_max_pool2d
methods.description: Performs 2D max pooling using MKLDNN if enabled, otherwise raises an error.

methods.name: mkldnn_max_pool3d
methods.description: Performs 3D max pooling using MKLDNN if enabled, otherwise raises an error.

methods.name: mkldnn_avg_pool2d
methods.description: Performs 2D average pooling using MKLDNN if enabled, otherwise raises an error.

methods.name: mkldnn_avg_pool3d
methods.description: Performs 3D average pooling using MKLDNN if enabled, otherwise raises an error.

methods.name: mkldnn_adaptive_avg_pool2d
methods.description: Performs adaptive 2D average pooling using MKLDNN if enabled, otherwise raises an error.

methods.name: mkldnn_max_pool2d_backward
methods.description: Backward pass for 2D max pooling using MKLDNN if enabled, otherwise raises an error.

methods.name: mkldnn_max_pool3d_backward
methods.description: Backward pass for 3D max pooling using MKLDNN if enabled, otherwise raises an error.

methods.name: mkldnn_avg_pool2d_backward
methods.description: Backward pass for 2D average pooling using MKLDNN if enabled, otherwise raises an error.

methods.name: mkldnn_avg_pool3d_backward
methods.description: Backward pass for 3D average pooling using MKLDNN if enabled, otherwise raises an error.

methods.name: mkldnn_adaptive_avg_pool2d_backward
methods.description: Backward pass for adaptive 2D average pooling using MKLDNN if enabled, otherwise raises an error.
